subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: What safe and authoritative diagnostic contract may user-facing context-overflow messages expose across private chats, shared channels, logs, and UI clients?
rationale: Implementation depends on maintainer intent for session-label redaction and whether provider-observed, precheck-estimated, or stored token values are safe and accurate enough to display as context size and overage.

options.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose a sanitized display label, provider/model, effective limit, and clearly marked observed or estimated usage while omitting raw keys, paths, and unavailable overage values.

options.title: Limit diagnostic scope
options.body: Show only provider/model, effective limit, and recovery actions, leaving session identity and usage counts to `/status` and logs.

options.title: Keep generic guidance
options.body: Retain the current message and rely on `/status`, logs, and documentation for diagnosis.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose a sanitized display label, provider/model, effective limit, and clearly marked observed or estimated usage while omitting raw keys, paths, and unavailable overage values.
